Reminders engineering vs zh-Hans listing copy — two different jobs

Teams assume reminder capability covers storefront language. Xcode, Developer portal, and Connect actually separate in-app reminder behavior from product-page copy:

  • EventKit / EKReminder & Reminders framework — configured in your app to create, read, or sync reminder records. Controls whether Add reminder sheets and due-date pickers work. Does not generate Chinese listing text. AppLocale does not implement this.
  • Notification scheduling & alert delivery — UserNotifications, local alerts, and push payloads that fire when a due date arrives. Separate from the zh-Hans description paragraph that explains reminder value to buyers.
  • In-app reminder UI & field labels — task titles, due-date fields, and Remind me toggles on your screens. Your listing may mention due dates; implementing reminder write logic is engineering work, not listing copy.
  • Pricing and Availability → China — makes the app downloadable on the China App Store. Separate from language rows.
  • App Store tab → Chinese (Simplified) localization — independent row for title, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text, screenshots, and caption lines. Empty or English here means China buyers see English fallback regardless of reminder features in the binary.

Working Add reminder flows in the binary and a localized China listing are both required when you sell on the China storefront — neither replaces the other.

Reminders-specific listing copy — what translates differently

Reminder-centric listings use vocabulary general utility guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese App Store readers describe due dates and task lists — not a literal paste of US marketing:

Add reminder vs Remind me vs due date

US pages use "Add reminder", "Remind me", "Due date", or "Set a deadline." Chinese buyers expect concise 添加提醒, 提醒我, 截止日期, or 待办事项 phrasing rather than English slogans left on screenshot overlays — without implying you are the built-in Reminders app or a full project-management suite.

Reminder lists vs one-off tasks

Screenshot overlays and description leads reference whether users manage recurring lists, shopping checklists, or single due-date alerts. Chinese buyers expect concrete labels (提醒列表, 待办清单, 到期提醒) rather than vague English slogans ("Stay organized", "Never forget") that hide what the reminder flow actually does.

Sync to Apple Reminders claims

Some listings reference saving tasks into the system Reminders app or syncing due dates across devices. These are factual product claims in description or screenshot copy — not substitutes for implementing reminder integration in your app, which AppLocale does not engineer.

Subtitle and keyword packing

The 30-character subtitle and 100-character keyword field need reminder-relevant search terms Chinese buyers type — see Simplified Chinese keywords & subtitle for field mechanics. Terms like 提醒, 待办, and 截止日期 each signal different intent from generic productivity keywords.

Screenshot captions on reminder-list frames

Gallery frames that show Add reminder sheets, due-date pickers, Remind me toggles, or task-list views need one-line zh-Hans captions — "一键添加提醒，设置截止日期" not "Add reminder" burned into the product page story.

Common mistakes on Reminders zh-Hans listings

  • Assuming reminder features localizes automatically — EKReminder or in-app task logic wired in Xcode; zh-Hans row never added or left blank
  • Only translating the description — subtitle, keywords, and reminder-themed screenshot caption lines still English
  • Conflating Remind me with Add to Calendar — calendar event alerts and reminder-list due dates use different buyer vocabulary; see Add to Calendar listing guide for EventKit event copy, not this page
  • Calling the app "Reminders replacement" — 替代提醒事项 overclaims when the app only adds in-app tasks or syncs a subset of lists
  • Implying guaranteed alert delivery — listing claims every reminder fires on time when delivery depends on notification permissions and OS behavior
  • Conflating listing copy with in-app reminder field labels — due-date picker strings and task title placeholders are binary localization, not Connect metadata
  • English "Remind me" on zh-Hans screenshots — Connect caption fields are Chinese but burned-in reminder mockups on PNG exports are still Latin
  • What's New still English after reminders launch — see What's New in Simplified Chinese when Add reminder or due-date features shipped in a recent version
  • Expecting AppLocale to implement EKReminder or notification scheduling — Reminders framework wiring and UserNotifications code are outside listing rewrite
